Thanks to our International Advisory Committee

The IAC has made several recommendations to the Board on Registry Event Rules which the Board has adopted:
•     Maintaining the number of required competitors to 60
•     Changing the venue requirement to meeting specific structural requirements                         (see separate article for final approved
      requirements), rather than hotels as the primary default venue
•     Providing a 3 year pathway for current Registry Events to meet the new venue requirements
The Board continues to be thankful to the IAC for all their assistance this past year. We view this collaboration as a
huge success, and hope that this team is willing to continue being our partner!


Help us keep our WSDC calendar up to date


As a reminder, Member events need to fill out an event form every year with their prospective dates and event
details.  We need your event listed and your partnership in keeping the calendar accurate not only to inform our
dancers about your event, but also to assist new events that are applying for membership.  We want to see your spot
on the calendar, so that new events are able to select locations and dates that comply with our time distance rules.
